interactions.title: Two visitors detect the Firstborn
lines: DM: And we begin… with a scene again outside of the storm, with these two humanoid figures staring, standing and staring at some kind of strange energy meter device, and emotional at what they're seeing, and commenting that these signatures are impossible. How could this be here? But that it's unmistakable that indeed, on this strange island on the other side of the storm, there are these four unmistakable signatures. And the scene closes with them saying, “There are Firstborn here.”

before: DM: Okay. Everyone, why don't we just take a quick moment before we begin? Yeah. Close our eyes. Take a deep breath. Shit. And take… two more breaths at your own pace, and just release… you… whatever was going on in your day. You… just release whatever…

DM: Take one… Go into some emptiness. And hopefully now, you're starting to be in an empty place. Take one more breath. Just really feel… the emptiness of the space around me. And keep your eyes closed. You… as you start to… enter your character. Start to imagine yourself inside your dragonet. Feel your wings. Feel your fingers and your claws.

DM: And start to just feel the personality of your character, and how he likes to feel. What makes him… smile and laugh and angry. Just kinda stretch your wings a little bit. And feel yourself in that character. And how good it feels to have wings. And how good it feels to have… an awesome fucking life. And cool new powers and abilities that you just discovered a few hours ago. And also how fucking epic this day has been, or those past 24-36 hours has been. And as you now feel embodied in your characters, feel free to open your eyes.
after: DM: And… as we exit this vessel and cross through the barriers of the storm, back into the circular island, we encounter… honestly, a pretty different scene. As we shift, we encounter, inside of… the ship, or inside the statue of the Wanderer, this scene of… the four of you…
Zeno: Can…

DM: You… sitting inside… a cockpit. Which… again, as you kind of just step back for a second on how awesome this day has been—I think for all of you, probably the coolest day of your entire lives. Maybe, maybe not, we'll see, you can all reflect on that in a moment. You… but… Each of you, sitting… in a seat that, by the way, to re-emphasize, is custom made for dragonets, like it's like perfectly your size. And it was like that when you showed up. There's other kind of features in this hall and this other space that are not made for dragonets, but these are made for dragonets. And these seats feel good again. Very, very much the old chair, the old familiar chair that you've loved to sit in your whole lives.

DM: And as you sit in your seats, reflecting on what has occurred over the past, you know, day or so: you're enjoying this amazing festival with your dragonet community. Some kind of crazy egg appears that you go and hug, you have some insane vision of some terrible land with a burnt red sky, a dragonet dying, a divine light coming, and you somehow becoming that light, shooting across some time-space continuum thing, ending up in the palm of the Wanderer, waking up, having weird, strange abilities and sensations. There's food machines and other things interacting and waking up all over the island, and then you make your way to the Wanderer, somehow get inside, and are here. And we ended last session with each of you trying to make the Wanderer do things collectively. And if you'll remember, you had tried to make the Wanderer walk. And as you had started that process, energy started to surge throughout the space as you were all collectively imagining the Wanderer actually doing something. And as that energy surged throughout the Wanderer, we concluded. And we'll begin this session now, our final session. I'd love for each of you to describe…

DM: How are you feeling right now? Sitting in these seats, inside the chest of the Wanderer, which all of you know, and have been around your entire lives, and, you know, Sculpit and Tony, for both of you, you know, the Wanderer is a particularly special place. And y'all flew through the eyeball of the Wanderer, and ended up in this weird place, and, you know, there are these, like, statues with lasers inside. I mean, it's been a day. So, I'd love for each of you to begin by sharing about your character's state of mind, how you're feeling, and what it's like for you to be sitting in this cockpit. You.

interactions.title: The Wanderer begins to awaken
lines: DM: ((Resolution mechanics))You all feel, and this is fucking insane that this is actually happening, because you're like, and again, the Wanderer has not moved here. I'm going to change the POV for a second here. So, the Wanderer… it's a fucking statue, you know what I mean? That you are slowly starting to learn maybe is not just a statue and actually is designed for another purpose. But you actually feel the creaking of toes actually beginning to slightly creak and wiggle. And what's crazy about the feeling in your talons: you have your own talons and the own feeling there, but something… it's like there's this other layer of awakening that is happening in your talons as you start to just kind of creak it a little bit. And it literally feels… it's that feeling of, like… after having slept for a super long time, and, like, you're coming back into your body, and it's sort of like, oh, you're stretching your arms for the first time, and what it feels like when you're waking up and that's happening, that's what this is like… It's like, these toes have not moved in fucking forever, but now it's like… Oh, shit. Toes. Sick.

before: DM: Okay, each of you roll a d20 again. Again, according to the same things: Insight, Acrobatics, Arcana, and Performance.
Sculpit: I got a natural 20.
Heska: Four.
Zeno: 28.
Little Tony: Something in the teens.
after: DM: What do you do next?
Heska: Walk. Come on, we can do it!

Little Tony: Yeah. Wait. Wait. Wait. Wait. Don't—I, I feel it for for myself and maybe different for a statue, but for me, I like seeing where I'm going. Like, how do we even know where we're going right now?
Sculpit: Let's try and see.
Little Tony: Yes.

interactions.title: Seeing through the Wanderer
lines: DM: So this is for everybody that's not Sculpit right now. Each of you… Heska, Zeno, and Tony… when you open your eyes and imagine opening your eyes, you open your eyes. And what's crazy is your eyelids feel so heavy and crusty, again, sort of like you've been sleeping for fucking days, or maybe centuries. And there's this kind of creaking feeling of, like, the fucking gnarliest, like, eye boogers you can possibly imagine.

DM: Things are opening. And what you see in front of you is a giant stone outstretched palm, and you see… in the distance… a storm, and amazing clouds, and… you're looking through the eyes of the Wanderer.

DM: Also, also, also, also… You feel almost like a voice in your head. If… it's more a sensation, but if the sensation had words, it would say something like, “Discovery unlocked.” Sculpit, for you… because you're, like, actually looking around? You have this weird fucking sensation because you can still see. Like, looking around the cockpit. But it's, like, overlaid over that is, like, another vision of what everybody else is seeing. And it's confusing. Like, it's like if you if you're you really you need to concentrate on which one you're seeing. You can't like, see them both at the same time.
Sculpit: When I see that, like, immediately, I'll close my eyes and try to pay attention to one, and then, like, open them and try to pay attention to another and see if.
DM: You can, with enough practice, you can kind of switch around, but you can definitely only do one or the other.

before: DM: Okay.

DM: You feel, ok, ok, ok. There's a couple things that happen all at once. As all of you lock in and imagine yourselves opening the Wanderer's eyes, you feel two things, at least, that happen at once. First, because you're… wait, are your eyes closed right now, as you're imagining opening the Wanderer's eyes? Yeah. Everybody's eyes closed? Yep.
Sculpit: Sculpit is just looking around.
DM: But you're thinking this.
Sculpit: Thinking, yeah. But he, like, is mostly looking at what other people are doing. But he's definitely thinking about seeing things.
after: Sculpit: Right.
DM: With your consciousness.
Heska: Now we just have to figure out how to walk.
Sculpit: I'm going to start thinking about lifting his foot. I'm not going to say anything. Sculpit is just thinking, lift the right foot.
DM: Roll a d20. Oh, well, everybody else think about what you're doing. If you're—is anybody else thinking about moving a foot?

interactions.title: Four roles in controlling the Wanderer
lines: DM: Okay, so all of you, you successfully pick up the boulder, you successfully pick up the rock, and then Heska. You know, again, part of what's happening here, and part of why you're rolling the way it's that you're rolling, okay? As you're, you know, over the course of this now, you know, this is, like, now, like, at least an hour, you know, or so, that you've been just doing all of this, talking, experimenting, and so on. What you're starting to appreciate about how you're actually controlling this whole thing.

DM: Tony, you're having this insight into, like, I have this thing that we collectively want to do and is this, like, thought about what it is that you're trying to do, translating into the system, this whole giant mechanical system. It's like, you're almost, like, kind of helping this coordination around like the connection between the idea and then the translation into the format itself at all, and it's almost like if your shit doesn't work, it's like everybody could be like, “Let's fucking do this thing,” and then the whole system is just getting weird, confused messages about, like, what to do.

DM: Heska, you're starting to feel like if all of the other systems are like aligned and rock and roll, it's like the physical attributes of what's happening with the system. It's like if everything else is locked in, it's like you are actually the Wanderer. It's like you are able to like throw shit and you're Heska now 10th level and it's like, oh fuck. Like it's an insane like as crazy as this day has felt and how you have personally felt about yourself. The fact that you now almost feel like you've got this like fucking massive hundreds of feet tall avatar that is like approximating some level of, like, what you feel like you can do. You process that however you want to process that.

DM: Sculpit, for you. There's like kind of a a multi-dimensional of like… like, this feeling of, like, power around what it is that is actually happening with the system. It's almost like if, like, you are rolling well, it's like the system is achieving its potential, like, in whatever it is. It's like, if you roll really, really well, it's like, oh, fuck, like, I want to throw the boulder, you're gonna be able to throw that as far as you can, and just whatever is within your possibility, you can achieve it. And you're like, you're there kind of almost expanding what is possible and helping the whole system like achieve what is possible.

DM: And then Zeno… for you, this is also performance. This is this incredible orchestration, not only of all of you together, like, orchestrating these different kind of parts of the thing, but much like in musical performance and as you are like a conductor, there is another kind of harmony, harmony of all of the parts that you are bringing in. And if you, your shit does not work well, it's like having cool, like a really strong throw, but then like not having the, it's like, it's like you're, you're, you're, you're the, you're the overall conductor of the harmony of the entire system and making the whole system function together.

DM: So, you're all kind of realizing, you know, the different ways that you're contributing to this and how if all of you are super aligned, the statue is really doing what you want to do, and if one of you fails, multiple of you fails, it's… it's not gonna work. But, you know, it's pretty fortunate that Heska is on your team, because now it's like, you're kind of not… never, like, doing anything totally poorly, but, but it's pretty sweet. Like, you're all, like, really, really enjoying this time. And as you're experimenting and you're feeling, you know, and you're pretty lost in this kind of experiment.

before: Zeno: Oh, That'll work next time, okay.
Heska: That's what I was just testing. Now everybody's dice are spawning. Okay, let Kong talk. Yeah, yeah.
Sculpit: Yeah.
DM: Okay. Wait, so, but everybody rolled over 20 on that last one.
Heska: Yeah, Yeah.

And… you should come and meet us to figure out what is going on.”
Zeno: Hmm.
Heska: Let's, let's statue jog.
Little Tony: Yeah.
DM: You wanna go over as the statue?

interactions.title: Oru insists they leave the cockpit
lines: DM: Tony, you hear a voice in your head again, and it's the shaman, and he's saying, “Tony, get here now.”
Little Tony: We're here! This is us, man!
Heska: Can we at least wave?
Heska: Let's make it wave and say, like, make it do this, like, come here.
Little Tony: Yeah, we're gonna walk… I think, like, we should walk over and, like, squat down next to him.
Little Tony: The… And then we can tell… we can tell the shaman that… that that's who we are, and we'll be like, I'm gonna… we'll do this, I'm gonna go… I'm gonna do a big pointy thing…
Little Tony: We'll walk over and squat down next to everybody, give a thumbs up, too.
DM: Okay, I mean, they're all, they're all looking at you, but… yeah, I mean, everybody's like, oh, shit, like, it's a giant fucking statue, like, doing a T and whatever, but, like…
DM: And then Tony's, and then you hear a voice, shaman's like, we need to speak with you. Like, come.
Little Tony: Oh, see, you need to be specific, Shaman. It's, you know, you know. Guys, we should probably go, guys.

before: Little Tony: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
Zeno: Yeah.

DM: Yeah, so basically what happens is, yeah, like the statue like kind of goes. Yeah, perfect. It's making noises. Again, you kind of have… It, like, you feel like you're kind of saying something, but then you're kind of like realizing that maybe this thing wasn't designed totally to say stuff out loud, but…
Zeno: It's like…
DM: But, but you also feel like… Like, maybe it could, but you're just not quite doing it right. But it's making a noise, it's going like… Like that.

interactions.title: Meeting Shai and Aksha
lines: DM: Approach the this this crash site, and these, you know… And then there's basically, as far as you can tell, it feels like some kind of game of call and response is happening. Or it's like they're like a bunch of dragonets or like… And then the two humanoids—you don't sense at all that they're threatening in any way. They're just kind of like, they're, they're engaging. They're trying to like kind of understand each other. And the shaman basically comes over and is like… “Okay, so… The day gets, you know, the past couple days, as crazy as this has been, it's getting weirder, that thing fell out of the sky, and then, these 2 humanoids that are like the statues, except way smaller. And, you know, like, I think we've had a little idea that there were maybe statue-sized things, but, like, not statue-sized things, like, kind of like the humanoids, but… They're trying to say stuff, we don't understand anything they're saying. Hmm. I don't know if you can help us, Tony, but…”

DM: There seems like a… this is… like, and basically, like, you kind of look over and realize the dragonets are trying to play… it's like some version of charades, and they're trying to be like, you know, and there's kind of this, like, a bunch of, like, gesticulating back and forth, but there's no actual… that you can sense of it yet, you know, real communication happening. What do you do?
Little Tony: Oh, okay, I'll give that a shot. I will come over, and I will say… Like, in… in very simple Draconic, like, “Hello, me, Tony.”
DM: And you're, you're communicating this telepathically? Yep. You see both of the humanoids kind of like look up and they're like, You, Tony? In your mind.
DM: You? And then one of them points at themselves and says…
Little Tony: Shy. Guys, this one's shy. We should talk to the other one to keep this one feeling comfortable.
DM: And then the, the, the one that's like Shai is like… “Aksha.”
Little Tony: Aksha. Aksha. Okay, Aksha, Shai, we're getting somewhere.
Little Tony: Let me level with you guys. It's been a weird-ass day. What are you doing here?
Little Tony: Why do you look like tiny little flesh versions of the statues?

DM: You hear them saying to each other, “I think this one is inside our minds, and I think it can understand what we're saying.” And then the other one says, and this is like Shai talking to Aksha and Aksha's like, “I think I feel it too. I wonder if we can… get it to say hello again?”
Little Tony: Hello again? I'll say.
DM: They both, like, turn and snap their necks and look over.

DM: And for everybody else, again, it feels like this telepathic audience. It's like, you can kind of see… like, you're all in a room together, and it's like, you can see Tony talking to the two of them, and you're all kind of, like, watching. And you can all talk to Tony, but you can't necessarily talk to them. But it's kind of this like, but there is like a it's you're all starting to figure out how you might actually have a conversation now.
Little Tony: I said it is. I think they're sentient. They seem to be thinking and communicating on their own.

DM: The two humanoids, now that it feels, like… Actually, it's possible to communicate. One of them… Basically, you sense and kind of can feel like just like a sense of like weeping and like relief. This is like one of the humanoids just starts like kind of shuddering, like crying. And then the other one's kind of like embracing it. And then…
Little Tony: Oh, buddy, I'm gonna come over and try and give him a hug.
Little Tony: I'm gonna, like, walk over and, like, reach my arms out, like, come on, bring it in, bring it in. Bring it in, guys, come on.
Little Tony: Back to the other three of you, like, come on, they need a hug. This clearly…
DM: It's been a hard day. They, they like collapse on the ground and both of them are just like weeping and like, you're, you're like literally like kind of group hugging them right now.
Little Tony: Yeah, I'm just giving him a pat, like, oh, buddy, it's gonna be okay, it's gonna be okay.

DM: This is, this is, yeah, they are all… weeping and just, like, shaking. It's like… it's like they've been… it's like the best therapy session that you've ever had in your life. And they're experiencing, like, that breakthrough moment, where… and this is that moment for them, as they… as they are feeling your embrace and are moved. Moved beyond words.
DM: And as you, you know, kind of wrap up the group hug, and they all, they all sit. They… You see them kind of lift and pull their masks up. And… And you sit… finally, to… actually speak. And…

DM: Aksha, who is the woman, and Shai, who's the guy with the beard and the top knot, they… They look at… the four of you. They look at everybody and the four of you and the Wanderer like crouched over and a st—I mean… And they're… they're… Shai and Aksha, they both just say, you know, “There are no words to describe what this means to be here, and to be with you. There's no words.”
Little Tony: That's really flattering. Thank you. I… you know.
DM: Everybody can communicate now, by the way. We're all, we kind of figured it out. You all know, figured out how to mediate through Tony to talk. None of the other dragonets can do this, though.
DM: “How is it possible that you're real?”
Little Tony: That's a big question.
Heska: Over a little, like… reach to, like… pinch one of them, just… and then, like, back off, because he's nervous.
DM: He, like, the, the, the… which one do you try to pinch?
Heska: The woman. But I don't get too close.
DM: So, you successfully do it, but she also, like, and, like, grabs your claw, and it's just, like, just grabs it.
Heska: No, I don't get closer to more than, like, 5… I'm not getting within 5 feet of her.
Heska: I'm like moving forward like I'm gonna pinch her, but he's too scared to actually…

Zeno: I could get used to this, this is alright, yeah.

Aksha's an incredible pilot. That's how we were able to survive getting through here. But… Was not easy getting through that storm. But we had to, to come and find you.
